book.name: Luk
book.title: Luk Jisas Krais Manö Aij u Luk kalɨ kƚiñ rɨka

content: Judas Jisas nɨp mumug ga
Juda kai Bred Yɨs Halö Ñɨŋagep ñɨn kub kale u, Pasopa a gɨpal ñɨn kub kale u, sösöl ga.
Bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub gau abe, bɨ lo manö hag ñeb bɨ gau abe, Jisas nɨp alun a gɨla u pen nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp pɨñɨŋ göm, aigöl gun alun a göm, hag nɨŋ mɨdeila.
Hag nɨŋ mɨdlö nɨŋöl gɨ, Seden nɨpe apöm, Judas hib nɨpe ap Iskariod a gɨmɨdal u, nɨp yuö hiɨka. Bɨ anɨbu Jisas bɨ nɨpe unbö mɨgan laŋ gau bɨ ap.

Yuö hiɨkö, nɨpe am God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub gau abe, God sabe gep ram abad mɨdmɨdal polisman bɨ kub kale gau abe mɨdeila gau amöm, Jisas nɨp aigöl gem mumug gɨ dam ñɨnö nɨp al pak löl, a göm, manö anɨbu kalɨp aip hag nɨŋa.
Hagö, kalɨp aij a gö nɨŋöl gɨ hagla, “Nöp mani ñɨnabun,” a gɨla.
Hageila, Judas nɨpe, magö mai rö Jisas nɨbi bɨ gau aip mɨdageinab u, nɨp mumug gɨ dam bɨ kub gau kalɨp ñɨnabin, a göm, abad nɨŋ mɨdeia.
Pasopa nan ñɨŋnɨg gɨjɨn gɨla
Pen Bred Yɨs Halö Ñɨŋagep ñɨn anɨbu auö, Pasopa kaj sipsip pi pak sabe gep ñɨn uri, a göm,
Jisas nɨpe Pida aip Jon aip kalɨp mɨhöŋ hag yuöm haga, “Kale mɨhöŋ am Pasopa nan ñɨŋnabun u gɨ lɨ aij gɨmil,” a ga.
Hageia haglö, “Gai anɨg gul?” ö gɨlö.
Hageila, Jisas haga, “Kale mɨhöŋ daun kub u ammil nɨŋnabil, bɨ ap ñɨg mɨl daueinab. Nɨp nable pakmil, arnɨm ram u ammil,
bɨ ram nap nɨbö anɨbu nɨp hagmil, ‘Manö Hag Ñeb Bɨ nöp hag nɨŋöb, “Ram raul mɨgan mai bɨ yad gau aip Pasopa nan ñɨŋnabun?” ö göp,’ a gɨmil.
Anɨg hageinabil, kalöp mɨhöŋ dam ram raul mɨgan kub debol nan gau halö mɨdeinab adö laŋ u hageinab u, Pasopa nan ñɨŋnabun gau raul mɨgan anɨbu gɨ jɨn gɨmil,” a ga.
Hagö ammil nɨŋlö, haga haga rö nöp mɨdeia. Anɨb u, Pasopa nan ñɨŋnɨg gɨla gau gɨ lɨ aij gɨlö.
Jisas bɨ nɨpe gau kalɨp bred wain ña
Pen ram dugöp magö u nan ñɨŋnɨg göm, bɨ manö nɨpe ud arep gau aip debol u asɨk gɨgabö göm,
kalɨp haga, “Gasɨ yad pör nɨŋbin u, kalöp aip Pasopa nan ñɨŋnɨg gabun i ñɨŋun me, hainö ilön kub udnam, a gem, gasɨ u nɨŋbin.
Pen yad kalöp hagabin, Pasopa nan u hainö kauyaŋ ñɨŋagnabin; hainö Pasopa kaj sipsip pi pör pak ñɨŋbun iƚ anɨbu waiö lɨnab nɨŋöm God nɨbi bɨ nɨpe udöm abad mɨdeinab ñɨn u nöp nan kub ñɨŋnabun,” a ga.
Jisas anɨg hagöm, ñɨg wain kap udöm, God nɨp aij a göm, bɨ nɨpe gau kalɨp ñöl gɨ haga, “Ñɨg ñabin i kale ke ud ñɨŋim.
Pen kalöp hagabin, mɨñi ñɨn i rɨkö, ñɨg wain kauyaŋ ñɨŋagnabin; God nɨbi bɨ nɨpe udöm abad mɨdeinab ñɨn u nöp ñɨg wain kauyaŋ ñɨŋnabin,” a ga.
Anɨg hagöm, bred ap udöm, God nɨp aij a göm, ud jö göm kalɨp ñöl gɨ haga, “Hañ romaŋ yad i kalöp ñabin. Kale udmim gasɨ yɨp nöp nɨŋöl gɨmim ñɨŋim,” a ga.
Kale nan ñɨŋ haköm, Jisas ñɨg wain kap u udöm, kalɨp ñöl gɨ haga, “Hagape yad lugö umnö me, God kalöp nɨbi bɨ yad, a göm, udnabin a ga manö adö u am pɨdöŋ gɨnab u me, kalöp ñɨg wain i ñabin.
Pen bɨ yɨp kain gɨ dam arnab u aip asɨk mɨdpun.
Bɨ Ñɨ nɨpe, God hadame ram haga adan adö u nöp hain göm umnab u pen bɨ nɨp kain gɨ dam arnab u nɨp mög nɨŋabin,” a ga.
Jisas anɨg hageia, bɨ nɨpe gau kale ke nöp, an rö anɨg gɨnab, a göm, pen pen hag nɨŋöl gɨ mɨdeila.
Bɨ nɨpe gau, “Kale wasö, yad nöp bɨ kub mɨdpin,” a gɨla
Jisas bɨ nɨpe gau, kale wasö, yad nöp bɨ kub mɨdpin, a göm, kale ke nöp pen pen hageila.
Anɨg hageila, Jisas kalɨp haga, “Kiŋ gau Juda nɨbi bɨ wasö gau kƚö göm abad mɨdöl gɨ hagpal, ‘Kalɨp ud aij yabɨƚ gɨpun,’ a gɨpal.
Pen kale unbö rö gagmim. Bɨ kub kale gau, ñɨ praj rö mɨdaiöl; bɨ kub yabɨƚ gau, bɨ wög gɨ ñeb rö mɨdaiöl.
Mɨnöŋ naböŋ iƚ i gɨpal nagɨ adö u, bɨ kub am asɨklö, bɨ wög gɨ ñeb gau nan magö nan kalpe gau pɨɫa pɨɫa gɨpal. Pen yad aŋ kalöp bɨ wög gɨ ñeb rö nöp mɨdpin.
“Yɨp marö yabɨƚ gɨmɨdöp u nɨŋmim yɨp arö gagpim; yɨp abad mɨdpim.
Anɨg gɨpim u, God yɨp hagöp, ‘Ne Kiŋ mɨdmön, nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp abad mɨdeinabön,’ a göp rö, yad pen u rö nöp kalöp hagabin, kale kiŋ rö mɨdmim nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp abad mɨdeinabim.
Ñɨn anɨbu kale ram mɨnöŋ yad u ammim, yad aip asɨkmim nan magö ñɨŋmim ñɨg ñɨŋmim gɨnabim; kale kiŋ asɨkpal sea adö u asɨkmim, Isrel iƚ ke ke unbö mɨgan laŋ kalɨp manö kub nɨŋnabim,” a ga.
Pida, “Jisas nɨp nɨŋagpin,” a gɨnab

Jisas nɨpe Pida nɨp haga, “Saimon, Saimon, nöŋ. God nɨpe Seden nɨp yau a gö, kalöp bɨ, wid magö hoŋ gɨlö hoŋ gɨlö, magö yabɨƚ u ke löm, adɨŋ adɨŋ u ke löm gɨpal rö u göm, kale gɨ naij gɨnabim aka wasö gɨ nɨŋnab,” a ga.

Pen yad God nɨp sabe gɨpin rö, yɨp böŋ nöp arö gagnabön. Pen nan si nan naij gɨnabön u, nɨhön gɨnɨg anɨg gɨpin, a gɨmön, yɨp kauyaŋ ado gɨ aunabön. Pen anɨg gɨmön, hainö apön namdamam ne rɨmnap kalɨp manö hag ñɨ aij gö, kale kƚö göm yɨp hain göl,” a ga.
Jisas anɨg hageia Pida haga, “Bɨ Kub, yad nöp arö gagnabin. Mɨhöŋgöl nöp ajeinabul, nöp nagɨ löm, yɨp abe nagɨ löl. Pen nöp al pak löm, yɨp abe al pak löl,” a ga.
Hageia, Jisas haga, “Pida, yad nöp hagabin, mɨñi sɨbön yaŋ kɨƚakɨƚ wɨñ alagnab magö u, Jisas nɨp nɨŋagpin a gɨmön, ij mɨhau nɨgaŋ wai ñɨnabön,” a ga.
Mani rin, wadɨ, ru mɨlö kɨd

Jisas anɨg hagöm kalɨp haga, “Nöd kalöp hag yuem hagnö, ‘Mani rin, wadɨ, ma rɨrup gau udmim ud aragmim; yɨharɨŋ armim,’ a gɨnö. Hagnö arbe ñɨn anɨbu, nan kale rɨmnap mɨdeia aka mɨdageia?” ö ga. Hageia hagla, “Wasö, nan hon uƚep laga; mɨdeia nöp,” a gɨla.
Hageila, Jisas haga, “Pen mɨñi kale mani rin, wadɨ mɨdainɨm u, halö ud armim. Bɨ an ru mɨlö kɨd mɨdagainɨm u, kolsior nɨpe u bɨ rɨmnap kalɨp sɨkim göm mani udöm ru mɨlö kɨd ap raunɨm.

Pen nɨŋim! Nöd God manö hagep bɨ Aisaia God Manö adɨŋ ap kalɨ kƚiñ rɨköm haga, ‘ “Nɨpe bɨ nan si nan naij gep bɨ ap,” a gɨnaböl,’ a ga. Haga anɨbu yɨp nöp haga. Manö hagöm kalɨ kƚiñ rɨka anɨbu mɨñi gɨnɨg gab,” a ga.
Jisas anɨg hageia, kale hagla, “Bɨ Kub, ru mɨlö kɨd hon mɨhöp mɨdöp,” a gɨla. Hageila haga, “U anɨg hagagmim,” a ga.
Jisas Olip Dum au Nap nɨp sabe ga
Jisas anɨg hagöl göm Jerusalem höŋ amöm, pör Nap nɨp sabe gɨmɨdöp Olip Dum au ara; bɨ nɨpe gau hain gɨla.
Ram mɨnöŋ anɨbu amjaköm kalɨp haga, “Gasɨ naij auö gɨ naij gɨmim rö löp u, God nɨp sabe göl gɨ mɨdaimim,” a ga.
Anɨg hagöm, kalɨp arö göm, nɨpe ke ke au amöm, kugom yɨmöm God nɨp sabe göm haga,
“Bapi, gasɨ yad nɨŋbin u ñɨg asɨ kap yɨp ñɨnɨg gabön u ñagmön. Pen yad gasɨ nɨŋbin adö u gagmön; gasɨ ne ke nɨŋban adö u nöp gɨmön,” a ga.
Jisas anɨg hagö, ejol ap kumi kabö adö laŋ au nɨbö apöm nɨp pɨdöŋ ña.
Nɨp marö yabɨƚ gö, Jisas nɨpe Nap nɨp kƚö yabɨƚ göm sabe göl gɨ mɨdö nɨŋöl gɨ, hapɨl u hagape rö pa gɨ dö gɨ iƚ yaŋ luga.
Nap nɨp sabe gɨ mɨd juöm amöm nɨŋa, bɨ nɨpe gau mɨŋör lugö nɨŋöl gɨ, hon haneila.
Anɨg geila u nɨŋöm kalɨp haga, “Nɨhön gɨnɨg hon hanabimŋ Seden nɨpe gasɨ ñö kale gɨ naij gɨmim rö löp u, urakmim, sabe göl gɨ mɨdaiim,” a ga.
Jisas nɨp ud sɨsɨ lɨla
Jisas manö anɨbu hag mɨdö nɨŋöl gɨ, bɨ nɨpe Judas bɨ ugan kub ap uɫ gɨ dap apjaköm, Jisas nɨp ud bom halunam a geia.
Anɨg geia, Jisas nɨp haga, “Judas, ‘Bɨ me i al pak lɨmim,’ a gɨmön, yɨp Bɨ Ñɨ nɨpe ud bom halunɨg gabön ar?” a ga.
Anɨg hagö nɨŋöl gɨ, bɨ nɨpe gau nan nɨhön gɨnɨg geila anɨbu nɨŋöm hagla, “Bɨ Kub, hon kalɨp ru mɨlö kɨd ud rɨbun aka?” gɨla.
Anɨg hagöl göm, bɨ ap ru mɨlö kɨd nɨpe u udöm, bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub yabɨƚ bɨ wög gɨ ñeb nɨpe u, nɨp rɨmɨd yɨjɨg lau böŋ nöp rɨb gɨ dö gɨ yua.
Anɨg geia, Jisas nɨŋöm haga, “Anɨg gagmim! Me aij,” a ga. Anɨg hagöm, rɨmɨd u ud nɨŋö kamɨŋ la.

Pen God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub gau abe, God sabe gep ram abad mɨdmɨdal polisman bɨ kub kale gau abe, bɨ manö ud asɨkep gau abe, ap nɨp udnɨg geila gau, kalɨp haga, “Kale ru mɨlö kɨd udmim, ur pakep udmim daubim u, yɨp bɨ pen pen alep bɨ ap rö a gɨ gasɨ nɨŋmim, ud sɨsɨ lɨnɨg aubim ar?
Yad kale aip pör pör God sabe gep ram u mɨdainö yɨp udagpe. Pen mɨñi Seden, bɨ sɨbön lau adö mɨdöp u, ñɨn nɨpe u me, anɨg gabim,” a ga.
Pida, Jisas nɨp nɨŋagpin, a ga
Jisas anɨg hagö nɨŋöl gɨ, nɨp ud sɨsɨ löm, dam God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub yabɨƚ ram u ud arla. Pida pen hain hain nɨŋ ara.
Ram anɨbu apjaköm, ram goƚ au mab lauöm asɨk mɨdeila. Pida hain apjaköm kalɨp aip asɨka.
Pida aip asɨk mɨdö nɨŋöl gɨ, pai ram anɨbu wög gɨ ñɨmɨdöp ap nɨp nɨŋ dap ran lugöl gɨ haga, “Bɨ i abe Jisas aip mɨdmɨdöp,” a ga.
Hageia, Pida haga, “Pai, bɨ anɨbu yad nɨŋagpin!” a ga.
Anɨg hagöm, yöp pro magö ap mɨdö nɨŋöl gɨ, bɨ ap pen apöm Pida nɨp nɨŋöm haga, “Ne u rö nöp Jisas bɨ nɨpe ap,” a ga. Hageia, Pida haga, “Bɨ me, yad wasö!” ga.
Pen hainö pro pro magö ap mɨdö, bɨ ap pen apöm, kƚö göm haga, “Bɨ i Jisas aip mɨdmɨdöp me. Nɨpe abe ram mɨnöŋ Galili nɨbö,” a ga.
Hageia, Pida haga, “Bɨ me, manö hagabön u yad nɨŋagɨn me!” a ga. Anɨg hagö nɨŋöl gɨ, adɨŋ kɨƚakɨƚ wɨñ ala.
Anɨg gö, Jisas ado göm, Pida nɨp nɨŋ ij halö lö, Pida pen Jisas, “Mɨñi sɨbön yaŋ kɨƚakɨƚ wɨñ alagnab magö u, Jisas nɨp nɨŋagpin a gɨmön, ij mɨhau nɨgaŋ wai ñɨnabön,” a ga manö u gasɨ nɨŋa.
Anɨg nɨŋöm, rugu mɨƚep gö, maƚuƚ ral auö, höŋ amöm mɨɫöŋ ga.
Jisas nɨp hag juöl gɨ, pakla
Bɨ Jisas nɨp ud mɨdeila gau nɨp hag juöl gɨ, paköl gɨ gɨla.
Kale waƚɨj bad ap ud amgö nɨp u paƚu gɨ ñöm, nɨp paköm hagla, “Ne bɨ ke nɨŋban u, nöp an pakab u hanɨp hag ñɨ!” a gɨla.
Pen manö naij anɨbu rö, nɨp rapɨn iru nöp hagla.
Juda bɨ kub manö ud asɨkep gau Jisas nɨp manö kub hagla
Hilɨm halö, Juda bɨ manö ud asɨkep gau löm, God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub gau löm, bɨ lo manö hag ñeb gau löm, ap magum gɨlö, Jisas nɨp uɫ gɨ Kansol kub anɨbu mɨdeila aŋ au ud daula.
Pen Kansol bɨ gau kale Jisas nɨp hagla, “Pen ne ke hagmön, ne Mesaia u aka wasö,” gɨla. Hageila, Jisas kalɨp haga, “Pen yad kalöp hageinabin u, nɨŋö hagöp a gɨmim, nɨŋagnabim.
Pen hag nɨŋeb yad mɨdöp u kalöp hag nɨŋeinabin u, yɨp pen hagagnabim.
Pen mɨñi rɨköl mɨd damöm hainö gau, Bɨ Ñɨ nɨpe God Bɨ kƚö unbö ke halö mɨdöp u, ñɨmagö yɨjɨg adö nɨpe au asɨk mɨdeinab,” a ga.
Anɨg hageia, bɨ kansol gau magöŋhalö nɨp hagla, “Anɨb u, ne ke God Ñɨ nɨpe u aka?” gɨla. Hageila, Jisas haga, “Me kale ke hagpim me u,” a ga.
Hageia hagla, “Nɨhön gɨnɨg manö kub rapɨn hag mɨdun, bɨ rɨmnap hag nɨŋno, Jisas anɨg göp anɨg göp a gaiölŋ Maj mɨgan nɨpe ke hagöp nɨŋbun u,” a gɨla.
